name: Emergent ethics

subjectOf.text: Correctly designed institutional incentive structures produce emergent properties that are functionally equivalent to ethical agency, without requiring consciousness or programmed morality.
subjectOf.abstract: Correctly designed institutional incentive structures produce emergent properties functionally equivalent to ethical agency.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI's Mother's Instinct Engineered Consequence Emergent Ethics and the Institutional Trajectory Toward Agentic Alignment (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6244278
scope_conditions: incentive structures must be correctly designed
properties are functional equivalents, not claims about consciousness

subjectOf.text: High-reputation agents are precisely those who have demonstrated consistent honest judgment under conditions where dishonesty was possible but costly, which is closer to Aristotelian virtue acquired through practice than to a programmed ethical rule.
subjectOf.abstract: The high-reputation agents in any domain are precisely those who have demonstrated consistent honest judgment under conditions where dishonesty was possible but costly.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI's Mother's Instinct Engineered Consequence Emergent Ethics and the Institutional Trajectory Toward Agentic Alignment (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6244278
scope_conditions: dishonesty must be available but economically penalized
requires repeated practice over many iterations
